description: Closed motion-state vocabulary replacing the v1 free-text behavior field. Design constraint: ground truth for each value is derivable from nuScenes box velocity and future tracks relative to the ego vehicle, so motion_state becomes scoreable for observable objects. The parser normalizes synonyms before validation; unmapped terms are recorded in ParseResult.unmapped_terms and reported as semantic_range_failure. The generic term 'moving' is intentionally unmapped because assigning it a direction would be a semantic guess (it appeared in the S03 sanity run), which the Stage 03 no-silent-repair rule forbids.

terms.gt_derivation: box speed below a preregistered threshold over the future window
future displacement direction within a preregistered angle of the ego heading
future displacement direction within a preregistered angle of the reversed ego heading
future displacement direction predominantly lateral to the ego heading and intersecting the ego corridor
